notes_for_editor: Only one source: a single directory entry on the Canada Lookouts website. Two web searches returned only US lookouts with the same name (Washington, Arkansas, Colorado) and no BC record. The elevation 2129 has no unit on the page; the brief records 2129.0 as metres, which is not verified. The region label Bulkley - Nechako does not fit the coordinates; the brief has no local_unit and none was set. BC Geographical Names lists several Sugarloaf Mountain features (for example feature 16292, map sheet 82L/4, at about 50.2 N, 119.5 W); none was confirmed as this lookout, so none is cited. The story is below the 120-word floor because the evidence is one entry. The editor may prefer to hold it for a better source.
